node.statement: Validation-gated terminal instantiation: require node 1.2 to be epistemically validated before using it. Once validated, node 1.2 applies at r=q (with 1<=q because C is nonempty) and supplies one current reset isomorphism v_{U_q}:M_q->A_{U_q}, its recorded field epsilon_{U_q}=W.L*epsilon, and the two W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_q} bounds. The identities U_q=C and q=|C| then give v_C:=v_{U_q}:M_{|C|}->A_C and epsilon_C:=epsilon_{U_q}; validated node 1.1 supplies that A_C is extended epsilon_C-C*-algebra and epsilon_C=W.L*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon. Until node 1.2 is validated, this child—and therefore node 1.3.1—must remain unavailable for acceptance.
